description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Dell SonicWall firewall key=value syslog records. Extends upstream SC4S SonicWall inventory with conservative pack metadata, parser/env artifacts, Splunk knowledge, synthetic-equivalent fixtures, and explicit validation gaps.

normalized_fields.src_port: sport preserved from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads before aliasing to analyst source-port searches
normalized_fields.dest_port: dport preserved from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads before aliasing to analyst destination-port searches
normalized_fields.dvc: fw firewall/appliance hostname preserved from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads
normalized_fields.serial: sn firewall serial identifier preserved from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads

supported_transports.label: TLS syslog RFC5425
supported_transports.notes: Recommended production transport for SonicWall firewall logs into SC4S.

supported_transports.label: TCP syslog
supported_transports.notes: Use when TLS termination is handled elsewhere or source cannot use TLS.

supported_transports.label: UDP syslog
supported_transports.notes: Supported for lab/legacy use only; avoid for production where event loss matters.

source_log_version.name: Dell SonicWall firewall syslog key=value format
source_log_version.notes: Grounded in upstream SC4S parser/docs current on main as inspected 2026-06-04. Exact firmware/version event schemas and timezone semantics remain evidence gaps.

validation.source_log_version: Upstream SC4S SonicWall parser/docs plus synthetic-equivalent fixtures only
validation.evidence: Pack artifacts and fixtures are curated from upstream SC4S SonicWall parser/docs, Lite addon inventory, and community catalogue candidate community_sonicwall_pr_candidate. Live SonicWall replay and Splunk read-back evidence is not yet captured; keep quality_status=curated and trust_level=unverified.

test_event_sets.label: Dell SonicWall firewall headerless key=value fixtures

timestamp_policy.fallback_timezone: UTC in TLS send helper; source-defined in production syslog envelope
timestamp_policy.notes: The fixture file is intentionally headerless key=value text. The TLS send helper wraps payloads in RFC5424/RFC5425 with a timezone-qualified UTC timestamp.

field_delimiting.quote_character: double_quote for values containing spaces in supplied fixtures
field_delimiting.escape_policy: Additional real-product fixtures are needed before stating complete key quoting/escaping coverage.
field_delimiting.notes: Treat each physical line as one event. The parser follows upstream SC4S key=value behavior and preserves the original event.

source.reference: Upstream SC4S SonicWall parser/docs plus catalogue/generated/community/community-extra.json entry community_sonicwall_pr_candidate (https://github.com/splunk/splunk-connect-for-syslog/pull/5678).
source.notes: Fixtures are synthetic-equivalent and use RFC5737 documentation IP addresses plus example hostnames/serials. No proprietary Splunk TA content or customer samples are included.

curation.notes: Selected as a high-value firewall source from upstream SC4S and community catalogue evidence. Public upstream material is sufficient for a conservative curated pack, but not for validated/field-validated statements.

src.notes: Mapped when the SonicWall key=value payload supplies src.

src_port.notes: Observed in synthetic fixtures only; requires real-product confirmation.

dest.notes: Mapped from dst/dest when supplied by the payload.

dest_port.notes: Observed in synthetic fixtures only; requires real-product confirmation.

transport.notes: Mapped from protocol text where supplied.

action.notes: Uses message text as a conservative action placeholder until validated event codes are mapped.

signature.notes: Uses message text as a lightweight signature.

signature_id.notes: Mapped when message or event identifiers are present.

dvc.notes: Firewall/appliance identity preserved when the SonicWall key=value payload supplies fw; requires real-product confirmation before validation promotion.

serial.notes: Firewall serial identifier preserved when the SonicWall key=value payload supplies sn; synthetic fixture value is example-only.

cim.notes: Network Traffic mapping is partial and limited to upstream-confirmed key=value parsing plus common network fields.

src_endpoint.ip.notes: Direct source IP mapping when present.

src_endpoint.port.notes: Source port mapping from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads when present.

dst_endpoint.ip.notes: Direct destination IP mapping when present.

dst_endpoint.port.notes: Destination port mapping from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads when present.

device.hostname.notes: Firewall/appliance identity context when present; not complete OCSF device modelling.

device.uid.notes: Firewall serial identifier when present; synthetic fixtures use example identifiers only.

activity_name.notes: Message text only; not a complete OCSF activity mapping.

ocsf.notes: Optional OCSF mapping is not complete.

source.ip.notes: Direct source IP mapping when present.

source.port.notes: Source port mapping from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads when present.

destination.ip.notes: Direct destination IP mapping when present.

destination.port.notes: Destination port mapping from fixture-backed SonicWall key=value payloads when present.

observer.serial_number.notes: Firewall serial context when present; not a globally validated event identity.

event.action.notes: Message text only; not a complete ECS action mapping.

ecs.notes: Optional ECS mapping is not complete.

logging_presets.label: Basic SonicWall firewall ingestion
logging_presets.description: Parser, listener env example, fixtures, and minimal Splunk props. No drops or reductions.

logging_presets.label: Standard SonicWall firewall knowledge
logging_presets.description: Adds eventtypes and tags for generic SonicWall network events. No drops or reductions.

known_limitations: Not validated until real SonicWall appliance logs are replayed through SC4S and read back from Splunk.
Exact payload keys, event categories, and timezone semantics may vary by firmware/version and syslog configuration; current fixtures are parser-shape smoke tests only.
No default reduction/drop rules are included.

validation_harness.harness: SC4S TEST -> Splunk TEST replay/readback for Dell SonicWall Firewall key=value syslog

readback.spl: index=netfw sechub_fixture_marker="SC4S_DELL_SONICWALL_FIREWALL_TEST_*" earliest=-2h | table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product vendor_product eventtype src src_port dest dest_port transport action signature signature_id dvc serial id m msg fw sn proto app marker sport dport _raw

last_attempt.summary: 2026-06-08 local preflight found no TCP listener on 127.0.0.1:20031 and local Splunk TEST ports 8089/8000 refused TCP connections. Fixture replay, SC4S/syslog-ng counter checks, HEC delivery, and Splunk indexed read-back were not run.

evidence.summary: Command-grounded local preflight evidence for missing Dell SonicWall Firewall TLS/RFC5425 listener and unavailable local Splunk TEST ports; not replay/read-back validation.

required_listeners.purpose: Dedicated Dell SonicWall Firewall TLS/RFC5425 listener

required_splunk_capabilities: SC4S/HEC path can write to netfw

commands.splunk_summary_readback: index=netfw sechub_fixture_marker="SC4S_DELL_SONICWALL_FIREWALL_TEST_*" earliest=-2h | stats count by sourcetype source host
commands.splunk_detail_readback: index=netfw sechub_fixture_marker="SC4S_DELL_SONICWALL_FIREWALL_TEST_*" earliest=-2h | table _time index sourcetype source host vendor product vendor_product eventtype src src_port dest dest_port transport action signature signature_id dvc serial id m msg fw sn proto app marker sport dport _raw

explicit_gaps: Real SonicWall appliance, firmware version, log category mix, collector wrapper delivery, and source-local timezone behavior are not proven by this harness
TCP/UDP syslog production variants remain deployment variants; this disposable harness exercises the included dedicated TLS/RFC5425 listener helper
Field validation with retained real product/source-version telemetry requires sanctioned samples or a non-production SonicWall test feed

source_delivery.notes: SonicWall firewall logs are native syslog key=value records.
source_delivery.validation_status: metadata_classification_only; does not imply live replay/read-back validation
